title: GraphMutation v1
description: Single graph mutation operation applied during ingestion or API write. Each mutation either upserts a vertex/edge into the graph or tombstones (soft-deletes) it. Mutations are the atomic unit of graph change tracking.

mutation_id.description: Unique identifier for this mutation. Used for idempotency and audit trail correlation.

operation.description: UPSERT: create or update the entity. TOMBSTONE: soft-delete with retention of metadata for temporal queries.

target_kind.description: Whether this mutation targets a graph vertex (node) or edge (relationship).

payload.description: Entity data. For VERTEX: must include canonical_id and label. For EDGE: must include from_id, to_id, and label.

ingestion_run_id.description: Identifier of the ingestion pipeline run that produced this mutation. Links to process lineage.
